description: This file defines the RuntimeProcessHandler class responsible for managing agent processes via Node.js fork(), handling IPC communication, session lifecycle, and process control within the kilocode project.

classes.name: RuntimeProcessHandler
classes.description: Manages spawning, communication, and lifecycle of agent processes using Node.js fork and IPC.

methods.name: spawnProcess
methods.description: Creates and starts a new agent process, setting up IPC handlers and session state.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific active agent process via IPC.

methods.name: stopProcess
methods.description: Gracefully stops a session process by sending shutdown and then killing if necessary.

methods.name: terminateProcess
methods.description: Attempts to gracefully terminate a session process, fallback to kill.

methods.name: stopAllProcesses
methods.description: Stops all active and pending agent processes.

methods.name: cancelPendingSession
methods.description: Cancels the current pending session and kills the process.

methods.name: hasActiveProcess
methods.description: Checks if a session has an active process.

methods.name: getActiveSessionCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active sessions.

methods.name: hasPendingSession
methods.description: Checks if there is a pending session.

methods.name: writeToStdin
methods.description: Sends data via IPC as a substitute for stdin.

methods.name: hasStdin
methods.description: Always returns true for active sessions, as IPC is used.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops all processes.
